description: backup.verify with drill:true is level 3: the copy is opened on a scratch database and the migrations that have not yet been applied to it are RUN there — the drill is the only place a future migration is exercised against a past backup. drillApplied names the migrations the drill ran, so the report says what was actually tried, and the ledger row records the drill (verify_level drill, the fixed template in the detail column).

report.sentence: drilled: the copy opened, migration 00000000000076_add_backup_run applied on the scratch database, and the counts agree
